title: gRPC and Protocol Buffers: contract, code generation and streaming

videos.script: So far boxoffice answered browsers and curl. Now the other programs of the venue need it too: the scanners at the door, a screen in the box office. {{rpc}} gRPC gives them a function to call instead of a URL. The contract comes first, in a proto file, and both sides are generated from it. {{wire}} On the wire, every field is a number. The jazz event is twenty-five bytes, against fifty-six in JSON. {{server}} Then the server, beside the HTTP one, sharing the same store. A unary call, and a status code instead of an HTTP status. {{stream}} Then two streams. A screen watches seats go down while sales happen over HTTP. A scanner sends tickets one by one and gets one answer. {{deadline}} Deadlines travel with every call, and interceptors are gRPC's middleware. {{evolve}} Last, how a contract changes without breaking the scanners already at the door.
